column1: # Generated by `lake exe oracle` (spec/Oracle.lean) from the definition in
# spec/Aontu: every value of the fragment up to one meet (600) against 24
# instances, the first 16 in rows c0 to c9599 and the other 8 after them,
# as `verdict` rows whose expectation is the verdict `check` gives, which
# `check_iff` makes the definition's own. Until P5 the definition gives
# admission only, so a refusal is written as the three classes it may be.
# Each row runs plain `vet`, its data written in aontu, exact numbers marked `0d`.
# Regenerate with `make spec`; never edit by hand. The cases the ports do
# not yet answer this way are listed in spec/ledger.tsv.
